title: Two Sum — Find indices of two numbers that add to target
description: Given an array nums and target, return indices of the two numbers that sum to target. Assume exactly one solution, no reuse.

title: Implement debounce() with leading/trailing and cancel/flush
description: Create debounce(func, wait, {leading, trailing}) that delays invoking func until after wait ms since last call. Support cancel and flush.

title: Implement memoize() with custom resolver and cache limit
description: Create memoize(func, resolver?, maxSize?) that caches results. Resolver derives cache key. Evict oldest when maxSize exceeded.

title: Implement EventEmitter (on/off/once/emit) — Node style
description: Build an EventEmitter class with on, off, once, emit, and removeAllListeners. Support multiple listeners per event.

title: Implement p-limit — concurrency limiter for async tasks
description: Create pLimit(concurrency) that returns a limiter function to run at most N promises concurrently, queuing the rest.

title: Implement deepEqual(a, b) handling NaN, -0, Dates, RegExp & circular refs
description: Create isEqual that correctly handles NaN === NaN, -0 vs +0, Dates, RegExps, Arrays, plain objects, and circular references.

title: Implement throttle(func, wait, {leading, trailing})
description: Create throttle that invokes func at most once per wait ms. Support leading/trailing options, plus cancel/flush.

title: Implement curry(func) with placeholder support
description: Create curry that transforms f(a,b,c) into f(a)(b)(c) or f(a,b)(c). Support lodash-style placeholder _. Use func.length for arity.

title: Implement Array.prototype.flat() — flatten with depth
description: Create flat(arr, depth=1) that flattens nested arrays up to depth. Also implement flatMap.

title: Implement once(func) — ensure a function runs only once
description: Create once(func) that invokes func at most once and caches result. Subsequent calls return first result.

title: Implement Promise.all() from scratch
description: Create promiseAll(promises) that resolves when all resolve (in input order) or rejects on first rejection. Handle non-promises and empty array.

title: Implement LRU Cache (get/put with O(1))
description: Design an LRU cache with get(key) and put(key, value) in O(1). Evict least recently used when capacity exceeded. Use Map or Doubly Linked List.

title: Implement Promise.allSettled()
description: Create promiseAllSettled that waits for all promises to settle and returns array of {status, value/reason}. Never rejects.

title: Implement Promise.race()
description: Create promiseRace that settles (resolve or reject) as soon as the first promise settles. Handle empty array (never settles).

title: Implement Promise.any() with AggregateError
description: Create promiseAny that resolves with the first fulfilled value, or rejects with AggregateError if all reject. Handle empty iterable.

title: Implement promiseRetry(fn, retries, delay) with exponential backoff
description: Create a retry utility that calls an async fn up to retries times with exponential backoff. Support abort on certain errors.

title: Implement lodash.get(obj, path, defaultValue)
description: Create get that safely reads nested properties via dot/bracket path like "a.b[0].c" or ["a","b",0]. Return defaultValue if unresolved.

title: Implement _.chunk(array, size)
description: Create chunk that splits array into groups of size length. Return empty array if input invalid.

title: Implement groupBy(array, iteratee) — lodash style
description: Create groupBy that groups collection elements by key from iteratee (function or property string). Return object with arrays.

title: Implement deepClone — handle Dates, RegExp, Map, Set & circular refs
description: Create deepClone(obj) that correctly clones plain objects, arrays, Dates, RegExps, Maps, Sets, and handles circular references.

title: Polyfill Array.prototype.map from scratch
description: Implement myMap that mimics Array.prototype.map — handles sparse arrays, thisArg, and does not mutate original.

title: Polyfill Array.prototype.reduce
description: Implement myReduce that matches spec: handles no initialValue, sparse arrays, and throws on empty array without initialValue.

title: Polyfill Function.prototype.bind (with new support)
description: Implement myBind that binds this and partial args, and works correctly when called with new.

title: Implement compose() and pipe() for function composition
description: Create compose(...fns) (right-to-left) and pipe(...fns) (left-to-right) that compose functions. Handle async functions.

title: Implement a Cancelable Promise (with CancelToken / AbortController)
description: Create a cancelable promise wrapper that can be cancelled before it settles, rejecting with CancelError.

title: Implement TimeLimitedCache (LeetCode 2622) with expiry
description: Design a cache where set(key, value, duration) stores value that expires after duration ms. Return true if un-expired key existed.

title: Flatten and Unflatten a Nested Object (dot notation & arrays)
description: Create flattenObject(obj) to {"a.b.0.c": value} and unflattenObject to reverse. Support arrays and escaping.

title: Implement Fisher-Yates Shuffle (in-place, unbiased)
description: Create shuffle(array) that returns a uniformly random permutation in O(n) without bias. Do not use sort with Math.random.

title: Implement sleep(ms) and delay with value
description: Create sleep that returns a promise resolving after ms milliseconds. Also implement delay(fn, ms) that delays execution.

title: Implement deepMerge(target, source) — recursive merge
description: Create deepMerge that recursively merges source into target. Arrays replace (not concat) by default; handle nested objects.

title: Implement a Promise Queue (TaskQueue) with concurrency
description: Build a queue that enqueues async tasks and runs up to concurrency at once. Support pause/resume and onIdle.

title: Implement dedupe / unique — remove duplicates preserving order
description: Create uniq(array) that removes duplicates. Handle primitives, objects by reference, and optionally by iteratee.

title: Implement intersection of arrays (with duplicates & order)
description: Create intersection(a,b) that returns common elements. Handle duplicates correctly and preserve order of first array.

title: Implement a minimal Promise/A+ (MyPromise) with then/catch
description: Create MyPromise class with constructor(executor), then, catch, and static resolve/reject. Handle chaining and thenables.

title: Polyfill Function.prototype.call and apply
description: Implement myCall and myApply that invoke function with given this and args. Handle null/undefined this and primitives.

title: Implement _.compact — remove falsy values
description: Create compact(array) that removes all falsy values (false, 0, "", null, undefined, NaN) from array.

title: Implement difference(a, b) — elements in a not in b
description: Create difference that returns values from first array not present in second. Also implement symmetricDifference.

title: Implement _.range(start, end, step) generator
description: Create range that generates numbers from start to end (exclusive) with step. Support single arg (0..end) and negative steps.

title: Implement lodash.set(obj, path, value) — create nested path
description: Create set(obj, path, value) that creates nested objects/arrays along path like "a.b[0].c" and sets value. Mutates obj.

title: Polyfill Array.prototype.filter from scratch
description: Implement myFilter that mimics Array.prototype.filter — handles sparse arrays, thisArg, and returns new array.
